construct WIN and MRW projections on every historical E0 pool
verify MRW differs from WIN iff the pool is mixed
render pairwise token-matched WIN/MRW evidence and verify exact token parity
verify nonmixed WIN/MRW rendered evidence is byte-identical
verify canonical evidence excludes system/provider/provenance metadata
construct ReasoningBank-style aggregation prompts from all eight trajectories and bind official prompt SHA plus explicit verifier labels
verify RB-style source caps and all trajectory provenance
verify WIN-A/WIN-B pre-provider inputs can be byte-identical by exact duplicate serialization
run unit tests and resume/SHA-corruption simulations without provider calls
measure local rendering/token counts and wall time for budget planning

changing renderer/tokenizer/cap because one arm looks scientifically better
go: all historical source SHAs valid, exact token parity on every WIN/MRW pair, nonmixed identity exact, mixed treatment exact, RB-style provenance complete, dependency pin exact, resume corruption check catches mismatch
